title: 고ICIR Defense composite long-only 20종목 IC-Return decoupling — factor quality ≠ portfolio quality
lesson_text: H_1682 Distress(Q25) + Calmar(R16) 60/40 composite signal 품질 IC 0.2207 / ICIR 1.879 / FM t=16.887 극강에도 4-variant sweep 전량 Hard Fail. 60/40 MDD 94.66 SR -0.242 / 50/50 MDD 95.63 SR -0.291 / Q25-only MDD 67.27 SR 0.009 / R16-only MDD 91.62 SR -0.206. 8대 stress outperform 0/3. Factor quality와 portfolio quality의 구조적 분리 확증. IC-Return decoupling 4개 원인: (1) Q25 Distress signal 방향 모호 (회피 vs 베팅 양방향 가능, Q25-only MDD 67.27로 false direction 의심), (2) R16 Calmar publication decay (past 24M 기반 → 향후 crash, R16-only MDD 91.62 확증), (3) 60/40 composite 방향성 상쇄 (Q25+R16 = '위험한 저평가 edge case' 방향 중복 증폭, SR -0.242 < Q25-only 0.009), (4) top-decile 20종목 Defense family 내 sector bias 전이. 교훈: Defense sleeve는 IC/ICIR만으로 Validity 금지. 최소 2개+ 병행 — (a) signal direction 명확성(Altman Z-flip/F-score binary gate), (b) sector-neutralization, (c) risk-parity sub-weighting, (d) non-linear transformation. Gate 확장 후보: variant comparison gate (min 3 variants, primary >= all alternatives) + IC-Return coupling ratio SR/ICIR >= 0.3. H_1682 Governor rev8-A (완전 DROP) 방향. rev8-B 재실행은 sector-neutral + binary Z-flip + risk-parity 중 2개+ 채택 시에만.
